findings.title: Loss of detailed error validation
findings.description: By removing IsOneOf and similar checks, the tests lose the ability to validate detailed aspects of the error responses, potentially missing nuanced bugs.

agent_decisions.reasoning: The code changes remove dynamic and detailed error handling in favor of hardcoded error structures. This simplification could lead to issues with error handling robustness and the ability to accurately validate error responses in tests. The removal of IsDict, IsOneOf, and similar constructs from the assertions in test cases reduces the flexibility and detail of error validation, potentially allowing for incorrect behavior to pass through tests unnoticed.
